canonical_intent: An intricate, beautiful fictional water-cycle world, readable as a five-tier exploded atlas. Visual compliance and aesthetic appeal are evaluated separately.

checks.criterion: Portrait canvas with width:height 2:3 (actual file dimensions).
Exactly five visually separated tiers, vertical order preserved, one central stack, air gaps visible.
Top tier has exactly three slender white harvesting masts beneath one curling cloud.
Second tier has three distinguishable exposed filter layers: rough basalt, black carbon, pale ceramic.
Middle tier is one clear glass sphere, visibly about half filled with turquoise water.
Fourth tier shows leafy stepped garden terraces and tiny gold bridges between terraces.
Bottom tier shows one large copper coil with white vapor emerging.
Exactly four thin copper downward arrows link each adjacent pair of tiers in the air gaps.
Exactly one turquoise return arrow on the right curves from bottom coil toward top cloud, with upward direction clear.
Title THE RAIN ENGINE is spelled exactly once and is the largest text above the stack.
CLOUD, FILTER, VAULT, GARDEN, RETURN appear exactly once each, spelled correctly, on the left beside the corresponding tiers.
Tier labels have thin leader lines, remain readable, and do not overlap illustrated components.
Museum atlas treatment, ivory/teal/moss/copper/gold palette, fine contours and soft 3D material shading visibly present.
Consistent elevated three-quarter perspective and broadly upper-left illumination, without obvious contradictory lighting.
Full stack/labels inside generous margins; no text beyond six strings; no people, logos, watermark, or decorative border.

review_order_method: SystemRandom shuffle of neutral codes after generation; condition submission order remained interleaved, not randomized.
